newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi airliner lands at wrong Indian airport.
newsitem.headline: Saudi airliner lands at wrong Indian airport.

text.p: A Saudi Arabian Airlines passenger aircraft mistakenly landed at a military airfield near the Indian city of Madras on Monday after the pilot confused it with the city's civilian airport.
The official Saudi press agency SPA said the Saudi Boeing 747 was on a regular flight between the eastern city of Dhahran in Saudi Arabia and Madras.
"The pilot contacted authorities after landing at the nearby military airport and told them that the aircraft, its passengers and crew were safe," it said.
The pilot said the mistake was caused by "the proximity and similarity of both airports' runways".
